java.say: CashRegister works out the amount due. The promotion comes in as a word.
A switch picks the promotion. "TEN_PERCENT" gives 10 percent off.
A new promotion means opening CashRegister and adding a case. Every change can break the promotions that already work.

cpp.say: CashRegister works out the amount due. The promotion comes in as a word.
An if checks the promotion. "TEN_PERCENT" gives 10 percent off.
A new promotion means opening CashRegister and adding an else if. Every change can break the promotions that already work.
